name: usaeventpartner
description: SEO-first US event production and trade show support site for international brands and agencies.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --var LOCAL_DEV:true
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npm run check && npm run test:worker && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run check:production && npm run test:worker && wrangler deploy
